# Unispace

> > Unispace is a global workplace design and strategy consultancy specializing in office fitouts, agile workspaces, and collaborative environments across Australia, New Zealand, Singapore, and beyond.

Unispace delivers end-to-end workplace transformation through their Think Create Make approach, partnering with leading organizations across legal, technology, finance, and healthcare sectors. The firm emphasizes talent retention, brand integration, and sustainable design principles in creating destination offices for the hybrid work era.

## Featured Projects

- [Project - Allens](https://www.unispace.com/projects/allens/perth): Allens Perth law firm office co-created with employees in 6 months
- [Project - BT](https://www.unispace.com/projects/bt-singapore-office-design): BT Singapore cyber security hub with customer experience center
- [Project - Leading Global Financial & Risk Advisory Firm - NYC](https://www.unispace.com/financial_risk_advisory_firm_nyc): NYC financial advisory firm One World Trade Center transformation
- [Project - QIC](https://www.unispace.com/projects/qic-melbourne): QIC Melbourne office: agile, collaborative workspace by Unispace
- [Unispace | Project | RAC, Perth](https://www.unispace.com/projects/rac-perth): RAC Perth award-winning 6-level sustainable workspace redesign
- [Project - Rolls-Royce](https://www.unispace.com/projects/rolls-royce): Rolls-Royce London King's Cross collaborative workspace with brand integration
- [Unispace | Project | Samsung, Auckland](https://www.unispace.com/samsung-auckland): Samsung Auckland HQ refresh with biophilic design and brand alignment
- [Unispace | Project | Smith+Nephew, Sydney](https://www.unispace.com/projects/smith-nephew-sydney): Smith+Nephew Sydney medical tech workspace with training center
- [Unispace | Project | Tonkin + Taylor, National](https://www.unispace.com/projects/tonkin-taylor-national): Tonkin + Taylor national portfolio with 6 Greenstar ratings in NZ
